units.source_text: 源氏向这边看看，说道：“列位大臣坐在外边，太亵渎了。

en.t: Genji looked over this way and said, "It is far too discourteous to have you ministers sitting outside.

units.source_text: 便走进东面的朝南屋子里去。

en.t: Then he went into the south-facing room on the east side.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王也换了座位，来同大家谈话。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, also changed seats and came over to talk with everyone.

units.source_text: 次级的殿上人，都在檐前排列圆阵坐地。

en.t: The lower-ranking courtiers all sat on the ground before the eaves, arranged in a circle.

units.source_text: 招待并无特别排场，只是椿饼、梨子、柑子等物，混合装在各种各样的盒子盖里。

en.t: The refreshments had no special display; there were only camellia cakes, pears, mandarins, and the like, mixed together on various box lids.

units.source_text: 诸年轻人便一边谈笑，一边取食。

en.t: The young men talked and laughed as they helped themselves to the food.

units.source_text: 下酒的肴馔，只是些鱼干。

en.t: The dishes served with the wine were nothing more than some dried fish.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督气色十分颓丧，动辄凝望樱花，陷入沉思。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guard, looked thoroughly dejected and kept gazing at the cherry blossoms, sinking into thought.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将猜得柏木的心事，知道他在回想刚才由于奇巧的机会而从帘隙窥见的面影。

en.t: Yugiri, the Captain, guessed what was on Kashiwagi's mind and knew he was recalling the face he had glimpsed through the curtain by that strange chance just now.

units.source_text: 他想：“三公主站得太出，态度未免轻率。

en.t: He thought, "The Third Princess stood too far forward; her behavior was indeed rather careless.

units.source_text: 那位紫夫人毕竟不同，她决不会有此种轻举妄动。

en.t: Lady Murasaki is different after all; she would never act so rashly.

units.source_text: 如此看来，世人重视三公主，而我父亲对她的宠爱不甚深切，良有以也。”

en.t: Seen in this light, there is good reason why the world values the Third Princess while my father's affection for her is not especially deep."

units.source_text: 他又想：“不多顾问内外事务，像孩子一般天真烂漫，原也是可爱的，然而叫人不能放心。”

en.t: He also thought, "Her childlike innocence, paying little attention to affairs inside or outside, is charming in its way, but it leaves one uneasy."
This shows that he looked down on the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 至于柏木参议，无暇考虑三公主的种种缺点。

en.t: As for Kashiwagi the Councilor, he had no time to think about the Third Princess's various faults.

units.source_text: 他只觉得：此次无意之中能从帘隙隐约窥见面影，定是年来宿愿可得成遂之兆，

en.t: He only felt that this unexpected glimpse of her through the curtain must be a sign that his long-cherished wish might finally be fulfilled,

units.source_text: 心中不胜欣喜，便越发恋慕三公主了。

en.t: and, unable to contain the joy in his heart, he came to love the Third Princess all the more.
